design_context: Internal Enterprise MRP / B2B Procurement Tool

typography.heading_strategy: Professional, crisp enterprise scale. No oversized typography in the header.

layout_specifications.scope: ONLY redesign the top header/navigation bar. DO NOT alter page body content.
layout_specifications.header_structure: Flexbox row, full width (100vw), horizontally spaced (justify-between), items centered vertically, generous padding (px-6 py-4).

elements: Small White Shield Icon in a soft rounded square.
App Title ('Materials Hub') stacked with a subtitle below it (e.g. 'Production Bill of Material').
SAP Connection Status Pill (Compact pill: Colored dot + 'SAP PRD Connected'). Positioned near the title to ensure connectivity health is always visible.
Search Input: Rounded white pill shape with magnifying glass icon and placeholder 'Find PR #...'.
Active Tab: Solid white rounded-pill background with dark teal text.
Inactive Tab: Plain white text with icons.
User Role stack ('APPROVER' in small caps over User Name in bold white).
Notification Bell icon with a red circular badge (e.g., '30').

menu_naming_conventions.rationale: Global MRP standards (SAP, Oracle) prioritize clarity and actionable data categorization over casual terms.

BOM Explorer.note: 'Management' implies active control, standard for MRP, compared to 'Explorer' which sounds read-only.

Purchasing Plan.note: Standard global terminology for inbound supply planning.

Production Plan.note: MPS is the definitive industry-standard term for high-level production plans.

Purchasing Strategy (Dropdown).note: Clearly encapsulates Supplier Master and Quota Allocations.

Admin (Dropdown).note: In SAP/MRP contexts, base component edits and write functionalities fall strictly under 'Master Data'.

component_usage.dropdowns: Shadcn DropdownMenu. CRITICAL: Must have solid backgrounds (e.g., bg-white). NO transparent backgrounds.
component_usage.search: Shadcn Input styled as a rounded pill inside the header.
component_usage.badges: Shadcn Badge for the red notification count and SAP connection status.
component_usage.icons: lucide-react (Shield, Search, ClipboardList, Factory, Box, Users, Database, Bell, LogOut, Activity/Wifi for connection).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the white text on teal background (#0E7C86) passes WCAG AA guidelines.
accessibility.focus: All interactive header items must have visible focus rings (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white/50).
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='nav-bom-management').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are creating a mockup of ONLY the top header/navigation bar.
DO NOT redesign the page bodies or KPI cards below the header. The mockup should represent the new header sitting atop the application.
Change the app name to 'Materials Hub'.
Apply the Deep Teal (#0E7C86) solid background to the header.
Implement the pill-shaped active tab highlight (solid white background with dark teal text) and search bar styling precisely.
Include the 'SAP PRD Connected' pill prominently.
Use the 'recommended' options provided in menu_naming_conventions for the navigation labels.
Ensure Dropdowns (for Supplier Management & Master Data) have a completely opaque solid background.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all) as it breaks transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (do not add .App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern interactive styles with micro-animations on hover/focus.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, etc.) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, etc.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust testing.
